newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hansol Group denies fund report.
newsitem.headline: Hansol Group denies fund report.

text.p: South Korea's Hansol Group on Wednesday issued a statement denying talk of an influx of funds into the group and saying there had been a misunderstanding.
The Chosun Ilbo newspaper reported that state prosecutors had evidence that the group managed a seven billion won fund on behalf of an associate of President Kim Young-sam's son.
"Talk about an influx of funds into the Hansol Group is not true," the statement quoted group information director Kim Jung-bo as saying.
"There seems to be a big misunderstanding. I hope the prosecution will uncover the truth."
The statement did not specifically mention the Chosun Ilbo report.
Shares in six of seven listed group affiliates dropped soon after the stock market opened as a result of the report, brokers said.
